patch.value: Add a reusable gated closeout PR workflow
Follow up on pm-github closeout with a workflow_call automation surface after command acceptance. Reuse the gated sync safety model without changing its existing workflow or inputs.

Run verified closeout on a bot branch and open or update a PR; never push main; validate tracker privacy, regenerate changelog, and dispatch required CI before publication.; Test clean, malicious, no-op, permission-limited and repeat invocations with explicit evidence; document least-privilege callers.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Claimed. Implement a separate workflow_call without changing sync inputs or behavior. Preserve default-branch resolution, npm project containment, exact extension pin, full changed-path allowlist, staged-diff privacy gate, strict health, leased bot-only push and owned-PR lookup. Closeout scans merged PRs since 1970-01-01 to avoid missing deliveries after schedule gaps. Tests execute the real workflow bash with real SDK trackers and isolated Git remotes; only HTTP and external command boundaries are injected.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implementation and caller docs are complete. Safety helpers intentionally mirror the unchanged sync workflow, with executable parity assertions. Clean nested-project closeout opens one owned PR and repeat invocation edits it; malicious acceptance criteria is refused by the proposed-diff gate. Pure no-op and zero-close caller-only tracker drift publish nothing. Read, contents-write, PR-write and CI-dispatch refusals are explicit. Added a fixed bot/default-branch separation guard. Linked tests are running via pm test; repository policy disables automatic test-result tracking, so verified receipts will be recorded in comments.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioural revert proofs: node --test --test-name-pattern=behavioural test/closeout-workflow.test.ts passed 2/2 (zero failures/skips). With only the staged-diff privacy scan call removed from the executable scope helper, malicious acceptance criteria and copied close evidence were committed and pushed to the isolated bare remote and a PR receipt was created. The intact workflow refuses that same fixture before push. With only the zero-close/no-tracker-diff conditional removed, a run reporting closed=0 opened a PR containing caller-only tracker drift; the intact workflow creates no remote branch or PR for the same zero-close case. These are real tracker mutations, real Git commits/pushes and bash extracted from the actual workflow; only HTTP/publication command boundaries are injected.

Covered owned-PR repeat behavior, schedule without repository metadata, all requested refusal/no-op cases, both behavioural reverts, input validation and competing-writer lease rejection. PM returned evidence_recording.reason=tracking_disabled under repository policy; this comment retains the verified receipt without changing that policy.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final permission review: closeout reads the Checks API, not GitHub issues. The caller and reusable job now grant checks:read instead of sync issues:read; contents:write, pull-requests:write and actions:write remain unchanged. Official GitHub Checks API documentation requires the read grant for private check runs. The permission-limited fixture now also denies only check-run reads and verifies zero writes/publication. Re-running the full gates on this final configuration; sync remains untouched.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Permission regression now passes through pm test: the fixture denies all PR reads, then denies only check-run reads. Both runs fail explicitly before publication and leave the item in progress. Existing command gap encountered: unavailable head evidence is returned as a skip receipt with exit 0, without a typed error code. The workflow checks unavailable/incomplete evidence in the receipt and turns it into a clear failure; command behavior remains unchanged. Final contract test and lint/typechecking pass with checks:read in both caller and reusable job. Full release gates are restarting with implementation frozen.
